title: Implement Parameterized Queries for C# Migration
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 banking code uses dangerous SQL string concatenation that must be replaced with parameterized queries in C# implementation
risk_if_unaddressed: Critical SQL injection vulnerability allowing unauthorized account access and balance manipulation
suggested_approach: Replace direct SQL concatenation with Entity Framework or ADO.NET parameterized queries, implement input validation, add SQL injection testing
success_criteria: All SQL queries use parameterized statements
Input validation prevents malicious account numbers
Security testing confirms SQL injection prevention
Functional parity with legacy balance/deposit operations

title: Add Transaction Management to Deposit Operations
problem_statement: Legacy deposit operation lacks transaction boundaries, creating risk of partial updates and data inconsistency
risk_if_unaddressed: Data corruption during concurrent deposits or system failures, potential financial discrepancies
suggested_approach: Implement database transactions with proper rollback handling, add concurrency control for balance updates
success_criteria: All deposit operations wrapped in transactions
Concurrent deposit handling without race conditions
Audit trail for all balance changes

title: Implement Input Validation Framework
problem_statement: Legacy code lacks validation for account numbers and amounts, allowing potential data corruption
risk_if_unaddressed: Invalid data entry causing application errors, potential security bypass, poor user experience
suggested_approach: Implement comprehensive input validation with regex patterns for account numbers, numeric validation for amounts, business rule validation
success_criteria: Proper error messages for invalid inputs

title: Reduce Agent Module Complexity
problem_statement: 1092 import relationships across 180 Python modules creates high coupling and maintenance overhead
risk_if_unaddressed: Difficult maintenance, potential circular dependencies, slow build times, testing complexity
suggested_approach: Implement dependency injection, create clear module boundaries, reduce cross-module dependencies, implement interface abstractions

title: Design Scalable Data Storage Architecture
problem_statement: File-based JSON storage may not scale for enterprise banking workloads requiring high availability and consistency
risk_if_unaddressed: Performance bottlenecks, data consistency issues, backup/recovery challenges, concurrent access problems
suggested_approach: Evaluate enterprise database options (SQL Server, PostgreSQL), design data migration strategy, implement proper backup/recovery
